name: @hyperion/api-backoffice
author: 4thDEVisionTech

scripts.build:bun:prod: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=production NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=bun nitro build --preset bun
scripts.build:bun:staging: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=staging NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=bun nitro build --preset bun
scripts.build:node:prod: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=production NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=node nitro build --preset node_server
scripts.build:node:staging: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=staging NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=node nitro build --preset node_server
scripts.build:cloudflare: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=development NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=cloudflare nitro build --preset cloudflare_durable
scripts.build:cloudflare:prod: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=production NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=cloudflare nitro build --preset cloudflare_durable
scripts.build:cloudflare:staging: cross-env NITRO_DEPLOY_ENV=staging NITRO_RUNTIME_PRESET=cloudflare nitro build --preset cloudflare_durable
scripts.preview:bun: pnpm run build:bun && cross-env NITRO_HOST=0.0.0.0 NITRO_PORT=8080 bun --env-file=.dev.vars .output/server/index.mjs
scripts.preview:node: pnpm run build:node && cross-env NITRO_HOST=0.0.0.0 NITRO_PORT=8080 node --env-file=.dev.vars .output/server/index.mjs
scripts.secret:prod: pnpm run build:cloudflare:prod && wrangler secret bulk .dev.vars.production --env=production --config .output/server/wrangler.json
scripts.secret:staging: pnpm run build:cloudflare:staging && wrangler secret bulk .dev.vars.staging --env=staging --config .output/server/wrangler.json
scripts.test: pnpm run test:con && pnpm run test:seq

README: This is a private package bundled by Nitro. dependencies lists only what consumers need for type resolution of the exported Hono routes. Server-only packages live in devDependencies to avoid leaking them transitively into frontend apps.
